# nexspence_user (Resource)

A local Nexspence user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_user" "alice" {
  username   = "alice"
  password   = var.alice_password
  email      = "alice@example.com"
  first_name = "Alice"
  roles      = [nexspence_role.team_a_dev.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Write-only: the API never returns it. Changing it triggers a password reset.
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `first_name` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `roles` (Set of String) Role names assigned to the user.
- `status` (String)
